# Faction War
◈ Faction War ◈ Declaration & Engagement System ◈
The [bold]Faction War[/bold] system allows eligible factions to formally declare war on each other during a round. Wars are structured - they have a lead-up, a duration, and an end. They are not free-for-all deathmatches. They are organized conflicts with rules, commands, and consequences.
## War-Capable Factions
War declarations depend on faction eligibility in the current server configuration.
## Timeline
Round-Start Cooldown
Duration: [bold]30 minutes[/bold]
Description: War declarations are locked for the first 30 minutes of every round. This gives factions time to set up, staff their positions, and establish themselves before conflict begins.
[bold]Pending Phase[/bold]
Duration: [bold]5 minutes[/bold]
Description: After a war is declared, both sides have a 5-minute preparation window. During this phase, members of either faction may use [bold]/warjoin[/bold] to opt into the conflict. Once the pending phase ends, the war goes active.
[bold]Active War[/bold]
Duration: [bold]30 minutes[/bold]
Description: Combat is authorized between the warring factions. The war runs for a maximum of 30 minutes before an automatic ceasefire is triggered.
[bold]Post-War Cooldown[/bold]
Duration: [bold]10 minutes[/bold]
Description: After a war ends (by ceasefire or timeout), both factions enter a 10-minute cooldown before they can declare war on anyone again.
## Commands
/war (faction) (reason)
Description: Declare war on another faction. The reason ([italic]casus belli[/italic]) must be at least [bold]5 words[/bold] long.
Who Can Use It: Highest-ranking online member of the declaring faction
/warjoin
Description: Join a pending war during the 5-minute preparation phase.
Who Can Use It: Any member of an involved faction
/ceasefire (faction)
Description: End an active war early by mutual agreement.
Who Can Use It: Highest-ranking online member only
## Admin Commands
/warend (aggressor) (target)
Description: Force-end a war between two factions.
/forcewar (aggressor) (target) (reason)
Description: Force-start a war, bypassing cooldowns and rank requirements.
## Rules
[bold]One war per faction at a time[/bold] - a faction cannot be involved in two simultaneous wars.
[bold]Only the highest-ranking online member[/bold] may declare war or issue a ceasefire. Rank is determined by job weight.
[bold]Casus belli is mandatory[/bold] - you must state a reason for war, and it must be at least 5 words.
[bold]Auto-ceasefire[/bold] triggers after 30 minutes of active combat regardless of the battlefield situation.
Wars are [bold]broadcast server-wide[/bold] - all players see war declarations, pending phases, and ceasefires.
